title: polygon
body:
## polygon

Creates a closed, straight-sided sketch profile (Sketcher::SketchObject) from ordered 2D vertices on the XY, XZ or YZ plane. It produces a profile, not a solid: feed it to extrude, revolve or loft. Choose it for L-sections, trapezoids and other outlines; use rectangle or circle for those shapes, since they are fully dimension-constrained in FreeCAD. Schemaxis closes the outline and rejects repeated vertices, zero area and self-intersection before FreeCAD runs.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A profile cannot be the output node; it fails with TYPE_MISMATCH.
- Schemaxis adds no sketch constraints to a polygon, so in FreeCAD its vertices are free geometry rather than named dimensions.
- Choose plane before writing points: the same [u, v] values land on different world axes on each plane.

Native binding: `Sketcher::SketchObject`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `points` | Ordered [u, v] vertices of the closed outline in the sketch plane, in millimetres. Consecutive points, and the last and first points, are joined by straight edges. Provide 3 to 100 points; Schemaxis rejects repeated vertices, a zero enclosed area and edges that cross or touch non-adjacent edges. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2},"minItems":3,"maxItems":100}` | **required** |
| `plane` | World plane containing the polygon. XY maps sketch u, v to world X, Y (normal +Z); XZ maps them to X, Z (normal along −Y); YZ maps them to Y, Z (normal +X). Choose the plane whose normal is the direction you will extrude along, or, for revolve, a plane that contains the revolution axis (XZ or YZ for the default Z axis). | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the sketch's (0, 0) point; every vertex is offset by it. Use it to move a profile along the plane normal, for example to stack loft sections. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
